title: Seven Deadly Sins and Heavenly Virtues
description: The seven deadly sins and the seven heavenly virtues that oppose them.

results.name: Pride
results.description: Excessive self-esteem and regard for oneself above others, traditionally considered the root of the deadly sins.

results.name: Greed
results.description: An excessive desire for material wealth or possessions.

results.name: Lust
results.description: Intense or unrestrained craving, especially for sexual pleasure.

results.name: Envy
results.description: Resentful longing for the qualities, possessions, or fortune of others.

results.name: Gluttony
results.description: Overindulgence and overconsumption of food, drink, or other goods.

results.name: Wrath
results.description: Uncontrolled feelings of anger, hatred, and the desire for revenge.

results.name: Sloth
results.description: Spiritual or physical apathy and the neglect of one's duties.

results.name: Humility
results.description: Modesty and a lack of excessive pride, valuing others and recognizing one's limits.

results.name: Charity
results.description: Selfless love and generosity toward others and toward God.

results.name: Chastity
results.description: Purity and restraint, embracing self-control over one's desires.

results.name: Kindness
results.description: Compassion, friendship, and goodwill without prejudice or ill intent.

results.name: Temperance
results.description: Moderation and self-restraint in appetite and consumption.

results.name: Patience
results.description: Forbearance, endurance, and the capacity to forgive and show mercy.

results.name: Diligence
results.description: Careful, persistent effort and a strong work ethic in one's duties.
